subject.title: fix(imessage): repair DM sender fallback before pairing

question: Should iMessage direct-message repair fail closed before access control when sender normalizes to destination_caller_id but no confident peer can be recovered?
rationale: The repaired sender becomes the authorization subject and reply target, so this is a channel identity boundary rather than a purely local refactor choice.

options.title: Require canonical repair plus fail-closed proof
options.body: Normalize all candidates with normalizeIMessageHandle, add regression coverage for local-handle aliases, and require after-fix live proof before merge.

options.title: Accept repair-only and track fail-closed separately
options.body: Merge a normalized repair for the known race while leaving unrecoverable local-sender payload handling to a follow-up item.

options.title: Pause until the remaining failure is clearer
options.body: Keep the draft open or close in favor of a narrower report if the author's current failure is not this sender-fallback race.

recommendation.title: Require canonical repair plus fail-closed proof
recommendation.body: Normalize all candidates with normalizeIMessageHandle, add regression coverage for local-handle aliases, and require after-fix live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows broad iMessage inbound and channel-ingress work, making this the best available routing owner for the security-boundary choice.
